archive_unit_text:
[Unit]
Description=Garmin sole original USB image, lossless compressed storage
After=local-fs.target

[Mount]
What=/root/garmin/backups/20261002T154458Z/sda-backup-v1.squashfs
Where=/root/garmin/archives/original-disk-v1
Type=squashfs
Options=loop,ro,nodev,nosuid,noexec
TimeoutSec=30

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
proposed_files_unit_text:
[Unit]
Description=Garmin sole original backup image, read-only research view
After=local-fs.target root-garmin-archives-original\x2ddisk\x2dv1.mount
RequiresMountsFor=/root/garmin/archives/original-disk-v1

[Mount]
What=/root/garmin/backups/20261002T154458Z/sda.img
Where=/root/garmin/backups/20261002T154458Z/files
Type=vfat
Options=loop,ro,nodev,nosuid,noexec,umask=0077
TimeoutSec=30

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
